summary: Rocky Brands, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 18, 2026, announcing that its board authorized an increase in the quarterly dividend to $0.17 per share from $0.16. The increased dividend is payable June 15, 2026 to holders of record June 1, 2026. The filing includes a press release. This is a routine dividend increase, not a special situation such as a capital return event (e.g., special dividend, buyback) or restructuring. No terms, advisors, structural mechanics, or risk-arb angle are involved.
